notes: Street furniture and road decals the Road Kit places (PLAN.md 3.6c, point_furniture.py is the one reader).
`kit` is the downloaded kit the pieces come from; each asset is a normalised kit piece (metres, +Y up, forward -Z).
A piece is stood on its own lowest point (`lift` added on top), turned so its -Z runs along the road, and scaled by `scale` [x, y, z] in its own axes.
`collide` puts an oriented box of the piece's footprint into the piece's collision (a StaticBody3D after import).
Distances are metres; `back` distances are measured from the stop line (the lane's end at a junction mouth) back along the approach.
`exclude_roads` lists road-name globs an asset is never placed on (a planter or a manhole does not belong on a mountain pass).
Edit and rebuild: the Road Kit digest salts this file and every piece it names, so a change here rebuilds every road piece.
